Repeating the same plot with the same data, but getting different results

First run

kmeans_spec_5 <- k_means(num_clusters = 5) |> set_engine("stats")

set.seed(17)

x <- rbind(matrix(rnorm(100, sd = 0.3), ncol = 2),
           matrix(rnorm(100, mean = 1, sd = 0.3), ncol = 2))
colnames(x) <- c("x", "y")


cl <- kmeans(x, 5)
mod <- fit(kmeans_spec_5, ~x+y, data=data.frame(x))
df <- tibble(y = x[,2], x = x[,1], cluster = factor(extract_cluster_assignment(mod)$.cluster))

ggplot(df, aes(x,y))+
  geom_point(shape = 21, aes(col = cluster))+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
~plot(x, col = cl$cluster)

Further repetition

Across all these plots there are a couple variations in how kmeans works for tidyclust, despite using I believe the same kmeans code.
